parts.text: How far were you able to be creative in your productions?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Analyse one of your productions in relation to the concept of genre. 
Section B: Contemporary media issues
Answer one question from Section B.
You should refer to at least two different media and support your answer with reference to contemporary
examples.
Contemporary media regulation

text: ‘Media regulation will never satisfy everyone.’ To what extent do you agree with this statement?
OR
Evaluate the challenges of regulating contemporary media. [50]
Global media
To what extent have global media transformed distribution? [50]
OR
‘Global media have removed the need for local media.’ How far do you agree with this statement?
Media and collective identity
How do contemporary representations of particular social groups compare with the representation
of these groups in the past? [50]
OR
‘Media representations of social groups can never fully capture their complexity.’ To what extent
do you agree with this statement? [50]
Media in the online age
Analyse the impact of key developments in online media in the area you have studied. [50]
OR
‘The internet has revolutionised media production.’ How far do you agree with this statement?
Postmodern media
‘Postmodernism is more of a style than a historical period.’ To what extent have you found this to
be true in the media area you have studied? [50]
OR
Explain why some media texts could be described as postmodern. [50]
